decks.notes: This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and utilizing Leyline cards to control the board and protect your creatures. The key strategy is to quickly establish a board presence with cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, while using Leyline of the Guildpact to pump up your creatures and Leyline Binding to neutralize threats. With a mix of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and counterspells like Stubborn Denial, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a diverse array of threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Ocelot Pride to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It also includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Static Prison to control the board. The deck has a strong emphasis on generating value through sacrificing creatures with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Voice of Victory. Additionally, it includes powerful finishers such as Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to close out games. The mana base is optimized for consistent and efficient casting of spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and creative spells like Indomitable Creativity to disrupt opponents and generate massive advantage. By combining sacrifice effects, card draw, and removal spells, players can quickly assemble a game-winning board state by creatively manipulating their own deck. The deck aims to surprise opponents with unexpected plays, while also maintaining a strong control game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. Overall, the deck offers a unique and strategic approach to combo-style gameplay in the Modern format.

The key concept of this Ruby Storm deck is to quickly generate mana with rituals and Medallion, draw cards with Impulse and Ral, then use Past in Flames to recast spells from the graveyard and finish off the opponent with Questing Druid or Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to create explosive turns where multiple spells can be cast in a single turn to overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a fast and efficient manner. The combo potential of the deck is enhanced by the synergy between all the cards included in the main deck.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and versatile spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm to control the board and maintain pressure. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Arena of Glory provide additional ways to close out the game efficiently. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast and aggressive creatures and spells.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing powerful Eldrazi creatures, using Eldrazi Temple and Cavern of Souls for mana acceleration. The deck includes disruptive spells like Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher to control the board and hit the opponent hard. It also includes support cards like Writhing Chrysalis and Ugin's Labyrinth to make it difficult for the opponent to stabilize. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of fast creatures and disruptive spells, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones using cards like Faithless Looting and Thoughtseize, and then bring them back to the battlefield with cards like Unearth and Persist. The deck also includes cards like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus to control the opponent's board and disrupt their strategy. The fast pace of the deck combined with the ability to reanimate powerful threats makes it a potent combo-reanimator archetype in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The deck revolves around quickly generating mana and chaining spells together to cast multiple copies of Past in Flames, allowing for massive card advantage and potentially infinite combo loops. The key strategy is to ramp up mana with fast ritual spells, dig for combo pieces with cards like Reckless Impulse and Glimpse the Impossible, and use Ral, Monsoon Mage to generate more spells and win conditions. By utilizing cards like Wish and Valakut Awakening, the deck can effectively manipulate its hand and graveyard to ensure the combo goes off smoothly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence with cards like Murktide Regent and Harbinger of the Seas while using spells like Thoughtseize and Sink into Stupor to disrupt the opponent's plans. By efficiently managing resources and utilizing a variety of control elements, this deck looks to outsmart and outlast its opponents in a one-on-one Modern format.

The deck focuses on assembling a combination of creatures and spells to create a powerful board state that can overwhelm the opponent quickly. Using cards like Basking Broodscale and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER to generate value and aggression, while utilizing Eldrazi Temple and Kozilek's Command for mana acceleration and disruption. The inclusion of Emrakul, the Promised End adds a powerful finisher to close out games. The deck also includes tools like Urza's Saga and Ancient Stirrings to find key pieces, while using Blade of the Bloodchief to buff up creatures and increase their threat level.

This Jeskai Control deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells, while also gaining card advantage with Teferi, Time Raveler and Nulldrifter. The deck aims to control the board with Wrath of the Skies and Solitude, while maintaining flexibility and versatility with cards like Stock Up and Dress Down. Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury serves as a win condition, while Consign to Memory provides additional utility. The manabase is carefully crafted to support the deck's three-color requirements, with a mix of fetch lands and shock lands for consistency.

This deck focuses on fast-paced aggression by playing cheap and efficient spells that can deal damage quickly. It combines powerful red burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain momentum and find key cards. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of direct damage and fast creatures.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, while also using powerful enchantments like Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding to control the board. The deck also includes versatile spells like Lightning Bolt and Stubborn Denial to maintain pressure and disrupt opponents' strategies. Additionally, the deck features strong finishers like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Scion of Draco to quickly close out games. The mana base is optimized for consistency and flexibility to support the aggressive game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and powerful creatures to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategies. It includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six for additional control options, while also featuring big threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to close out the game quickly. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also providing flexibility in casting spells. The deck aims to out-value the opponent through efficient removal and powerful threats.

The key strategy of this deck is to quickly mill the opponent's library using cards like Hedron Crab, Ruin Crab, and Archive Trap while disrupting their game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Drown in the Loch. This deck aims to fill the opponent's graveyard and then finish them off with cards like Tasha's Hideous Laughter and Fractured Sanity. Crypt Incursion serves as both graveyard hate and lifegain, while Jace, the Perfected Mind acts as a win condition. The deck also utilizes cards like Field of Ruin and Surgical Extraction to control the opponent's resources.

This Modern 1 vs 1 deck focuses on generating mana quickly through rituals and medallions to cast a large number of spells in one turn, aiming to combo off with Ral, Monsoon Mage and Past in Flames to deal a lethal amount of damage in a single turn. The inclusion of Wish allows for flexibility in finding key pieces of the combo, while cards like Inquisition of Kozilek provide disruption for the opponent. The deck also includes some card draw and filtering to help find combo pieces faster.
